scope: Two additional interactive keypad faces sharing FINDR's existing keypad rendering and hint-button contract
representation: Source-referenced HTML/CSS teaching illustrations with live buttons, not manufacturer firmware or product photographs

families.faceModel: Menvier MKP3 / M Series LCD keypad

appearanceSource.title: MKP3 Keypads — Scantronic and Menvier product data sheet

families.recognition: Ivory hinged case, offset dark LCD surround and green display, two indicator lamps, charcoal key recess, left function column, green ENT and red ESC/toggle

families.keyContractNote: Twenty physical keys. A/B/C/D form one column. The two arrow keys are separate buttons in the next column, below the two emergency-icon keys. C and D must not be conflated with arrows. The PDF text glyphs [ and ] represent those arrows.
families.recognition: Wide pale casing, horizontal speaker slots, grey recessed face, blue LCD, proximity symbol, rectangular dark-edged keys and a lower hinged-flap area

interaction.buttonNamespace: data-practice-action=key plus data-key; existing emulator renderer remaps to its own namespace
interaction.hintTarget: Each supported key ID appears exactly once on its matching physical face
interaction.miniature: Same face markup, with noninteractive spans and aria-hidden
interaction.mobile: Family-specific responsive rules at 550px and 360px; existing families retain their original CSS rules
interaction.lcd: Escaped live display text with existing accessible status semantics
interaction.keyboard: Shared practiceKeyboardKey export maps Pyronix A/B/C/D, NO/YES and arrows separately; Menvier T uses toggle. New families reject keys absent from their profile, while existing family mappings are preserved.

limits: Illustrated proportions and LCD font are adapted for readable touch interaction, rather than exact millimetre dimensions.
The open flap is represented below the keys without reproducing the manufacturer's full instruction sticker.
Pyronix emergency-icon keys are shown for recognition outside the ordinary menu routes; no live alarm connection exists.
The MKP3 datasheet disagrees internally on 16 versus 20 display characters; no claim about that count is made by this face.
